Connecting and checking robot status…
Cannot reach the robot. Check its current IP and that both devices use the same hotspot. Allow local network traffic in the VPN and disable hotspot client isolation.
The robot rejected the session. Disconnect the Unitree app or another controller, then retry.
This firmware requires the per-device key from your own Unitree account. Enter it in connection settings. This is not a Wi-Fi password or ChatGPT credential.
The device key did not decrypt the response. Check that the key belongs to this robot and enter the correct key.
The WebRTC channel timed out. Check hotspot client isolation and VPN local network access, then disconnect other controllers and retry.
The robot connection was lost. Check Wi-Fi, then reconnect. Motion permission must be confirmed again.
The IP responded but did not return a valid Go2 session. Check the device IP and firmware compatibility.
Connection failed
Fresh battery and posture data did not arrive in time. The connection has been closed. Check the network and robot firmware before retrying.
